description: Find available time slots for posting. Respects a 1-hour gap between posts and preferred hours (8am-10pm in the given timezone). Returns up to 10 slots. IMPORTANT: pass a timezone explicitly - default is America/New_York and slots will be off if the user is elsewhere. Each slot includes the UTC instant to pass as scheduled_at. Pass workspace_id to only avoid collisions with posts in that workspace. strategy "best_engagement" (needs account_ids) ranks the next 7 days by when these accounts get the most engagement, with a 1-5 star rating and a reason per slot.

account_ids.description: Filter slots for specific account IDs

count.description: Number of slots to return (max 10). Default 5 for next_free, 3 for best_engagement.

strategy.description: next_free (default): earliest free slots. best_engagement: best times by engagement (requires account_ids).

timezone.description: IANA timezone (e.g. Asia/Dubai, Europe/London). Defaults to America/New_York - pass the user's actual timezone or slots will be wrong.

workspace_id.description: Scope slot-finding to a single workspace (get IDs via whoami).

name: find_available_slot
